title: love it!
body:
It’s a really great app! I love that it’s full for free, pls never change that <3 
Futhermore, I really enjoy the minimalist design of the app.
The streaks / rewards system is good,but could be completed in my opinion.
The improvement I could see is to make a page with a calendar overview, to see how we did on average/our progress/consistency, and to have statistics of thoses numbers !
Also I would really appreciate if we could have all the color choices, or at least gray.
author: srh_ltrr

title: Good
body:
It’s a good app, but could use a lot of improvement. 
Monthly overview, moving between dates, personalising notifications/widgets (there’s only one widget option), for some reason whatever habit you create there are multiple circles to tick, this is useless for tasks you’d do once a day (make the bed or similar for example). 
Overall it’s a cool app and concept, but can be better. :)

title: Too limited
body:
There are two things I’d like to do and it seems it is not possible:
- I’d like to do something everyday once but at no particular hour. It seems that once the alarm is passed I can’t say I did the task.
- I’d like to do something everyday but one day (let’s say Sundays). Again doesn’t seem possible.
That app needs to be more flexible and more easy to understand. What do the circles mean and why can I check one in a few days?
 The app seems interesting but could do more.
